Перейдите в каталог `~/pool-start-autostart`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-pools-pool-start-autostart}
#### Запуск и autostart pool

Выполните:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-start lab-pool
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-autostart lab-pool
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-info lab-pool > pool-info-lab-pool.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-list --autostart > pool-list-autostart.txt
```
:::
